owner_target: EUCONS.ro is both Euroconsult's public interface and a practical engine for finding, qualifying, matching, preparing and helping approach prospective clients.

previous_checkpoint.reason: The previous checkpoint closed internal development against the earlier product scope. The 2026-08-25 owner target adds evidence-backed proactive prospect discovery, client-finder, next-best-action and human-gated outreach preparation as explicit terminal requirements.

verified_live_findings.finding: The live homepage is a credible service/lead-entry surface but is still primarily inbound and catalogue-led.
The live evaluation form exists but real transmission is still disabled at the public surface.
The live funding surface currently contains no actionable opportunity records; it states that the list remains empty when no verified projection is available.
The live project/evidence surface currently exposes two documented examples, so the public proof layer exists but is shallow relative to the expanded portfolio target.

gap_register.evidence: No repository file matching prospect discovery/client-finder was returned by repository search, and the canonical architecture has no prospect-discovery subsystem.
gap_register.target: Organization-level lawful public-source prospect records with why-now signal, provenance, candidate service, confidence, expiry and privacy classification.

gap_register.evidence: The public evaluation route explicitly says transmission activates only after the commercial runtime is closed.
gap_register.target: Production-authorized provider-neutral lead submission with minimization, consent separation, anti-spam, audit and deterministic recovery.

gap_register.evidence: Opportunity matching exists for lead profiles, but no verified prospect-discovery input model or proactive organization pipeline is present.
gap_register.target: Explainable FACT/INFERENCE/UNKNOWN/CONFLICT matching for both inbound leads and discovered organizations.

gap_register.evidence: The live projects surface contains two documented examples; the expanded owner scope adds CCI Valcea, Fundatia Antreprenoriat Social, Fundatia Centrul de Pregatire Profesionala Valcea and associated project history as evidence candidates subject to provenance/publicability checks.
gap_register.target: Evidence objects classified PUBLIC_VERIFIED / INTERNAL_VERIFIED_NONPUBLIC / NEEDS_EVIDENCE / CONFIDENTIAL / HOLD, with no inferred client/result claims.

gap_register.evidence: Canonical IA is organized mainly by services, funding, projects, team and organization type; the owner target additionally requires prominent journeys for funding fit, project review, implementation/reporting rescue and proposal/discovery intent.
gap_register.target: Intent-led desktop/mobile journeys with proof adjacent to CTA and progressive qualification.

gap_register.evidence: The live funding surface currently exposes no actionable records.
gap_register.target: Verified current opportunity projections where available, with freshness/provenance and safe empty/stale states.

gap_register.evidence: Analytics code exists, but live conversion telemetry was not evidenced in this rebaseline run.
gap_register.target: Truthful qualified-lead, completion, attribution, next-action and pipeline metrics; missing telemetry remains UNKNOWN.

next_unit.description: Build a current market-intelligence benchmark and convert it into a ranked capability backlog before implementing prospect discovery.
next_unit.why_next: The user explicitly requires market intelligence and market research to drive product strategy; doing this before the client-finder contract prevents building a generic or competitor-copied prospecting system.

validation.rollback: Delete this rebaseline artifact and restore the prior checkpoint semantics if the owner explicitly revokes the 2026-08-25 product target.
